ws3.ca_county AND ws2.d_year = ws3.d_year AND ws3.ca_county IS NOT NULL WHERE ss1.d_qoy = 1 AND ss1.d_year = 2001 AND ss2.d_qoy = 2 AND ss2.d_year = 2001 AND ss3.d_qoy = 3 AND ss3.d_year = 2001 AND ws1.d_qoy = 1 AND ws1.d_year = 2001 AND ws2.d_qoy = 2 AND ws2.d_year = 2001 AND ws3.d_qoy = 3 AND ws3.d_year = 2001 AND CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0 THEN ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0 THEN ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales ELSE NULL END AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0 THEN ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales ELSE NULL END ORDER BY ss1.d_year;

WITH ss AS ( SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk WHERE i_color IN ('light', 'midnight') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 286 AND 300 AND ca_state IN ('NM','TN') AND d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year ), ws AS ( SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk WHERE i_color IN ('light', 'midnight') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 286 AND 300 AND ca_state IN ('NM','TN') AND d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year ) SELECT ss1.ca_county, ss1.d_year, ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase, ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales AS store_q1_q2_increase, ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales AS web_q2_q3_increase, ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales AS store_q2_q3_increase FROM ss ss1 JOIN ss ss2 ON ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county AND ss2.d_qoy = 2 AND ss2.d_year = 2000 JOIN ss ss3 ON ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county AND ss3.d_qoy = 3 AND ss3.d_year = 2000 JOIN ws ws1 ON ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county AND ws1.d_qoy = 1 AND ws1.d_year = 2000 JOIN ws ws2 ON ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county AND ws2.d_qoy = 2 AND ws2.d_year = 2000 JOIN ws ws3 ON ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county AND ws3.d_qoy = 3 AND ws3.d_year = 2000 WHERE ss1.d_qoy = 1 AND ss1.d_year = 2000 AND CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0 THEN ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0 THEN ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales ELSE NULL END AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0 THEN ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales ELSE NULL END ORDER BY ss1.ca_county;

WITH avg_discount AS ( SELECT cs_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_val FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-01-14' AND CAST('1999-01-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 265 AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 65 * 0.01 GROUP BY cs_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM catalog_sales JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (117, 306, 658, 849, 891) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57) AS filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-01-14' AND CAST('1999-01-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) AS filtered_date ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk LEFT JOIN avg_discount ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = avg_discount.cs_item_sk WHERE cs_ext_discount_amt > avg_discount.avg_val ORDER BY SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH sub AS ( SELECT cs_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_val FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1998-03-22' AND CAST('1998-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 119 AND 148 AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.58 AND 0.78 GROUP BY cs_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM catalog_sales JOIN ( SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (291, 335, 604, 696, 887) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 35 AND 64 ) AS filtered_item ON filtered_item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk JOIN ( SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1998-03-22' AND CAST('1998-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY ) AS filtered_date ON filtered_date.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN sub ON filtered_item.i_item_sk = sub.cs_item_sk WHERE cs_ext_discount_amt > sub.avg_val ORDER BY SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_discount_cte AS ( SELECT cs_item_sk, AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-02-27' AND CAST('2000-02-27' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 260 AND 289 AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 75 * 0.01 AND 95 * 0.01 GROUP BY cs_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM catalog_sales JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (295, 363, 372, 688, 719) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 11 AND 40) AS filtered_item ON filtered_item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-02-27' AND CAST('2000-02-27' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) AS filtered_date ON filtered_date.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk JOIN avg_discount_cte ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = avg_discount_cte.cs_item_sk WHERE catalog_sales.cs_ext_discount_amt > 1.3 * avg_discount_cte.avg_discount ORDER BY SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1185 AND 1196 JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND c_birth_month IN (2, 3, 10, 12) WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 28 AND 87 AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 INTERSECT SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1185 AND 1196 JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND c_birth_month IN (2, 3, 10, 12) WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 28 AND 87 AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 INTERSECT SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1185 AND 1196 JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND c_birth_month IN (2, 3, 10, 12) WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 28 AND 87 AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 ) hot_cust LIMIT 100;

WITH inv AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov FROM ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47 AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425 AND d_moy IN (2, 3) GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy HAVING CASE WHEN AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) / AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) END > 1 ) AS foo ) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv inv1, inv inv2 WHERE inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 2 AND inv2.d_moy = 3 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

WITH inv AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END cov FROM ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM ( SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425 ) AS inventory JOIN ( SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47 ) AS item ON inv_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk JOIN ( SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy IN (2, 3) ) AS date_dim ON inv_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy ) AS foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev/mean END > 1 ) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1 JOIN inv AS inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 2 AND inv2.d_moy = 3 WHERE inv1.cov > 1.5 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

WITH filtered_data AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, i.i_item_sk, d.d_moy, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND i.i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports') AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 30 AND 230 ), agg_data AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean, CASE WHEN AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) / AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) END AS cov FROM filtered_data GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy HAVING CASE WHEN AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) / AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) END > 1 ) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM agg_data inv1 JOIN agg_data inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk WHERE inv1.d_moy = 1 AND inv2.d_moy = 2 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

WITH filtered_base AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory JOIN item ON inv_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim ON inv_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2001 AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 30 AND 230 AND d_moy IN (1, 2) GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy ), inv AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE WHEN mean = 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev / mean END AS cov FROM filtered_base WHERE CASE WHEN mean = 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev / mean END > 1 ) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv inv1 JOIN inv inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk WHERE inv1.d_moy = 1 AND inv2.d_moy = 2 AND inv1.cov > 1.5 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

WITH filtered_data AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, i.i_item_sk, d.d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory AS inv JOIN item AS i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Men') AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 JOIN warehouse AS w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim AS d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 2000 WHERE inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 376 AND 576 GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, i.i_item_sk, d.d_moy ), inv AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov FROM filtered_data WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev/mean END > 1 ) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1 JOIN inv AS inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 1 AND inv2.d_moy = 1 + 1 WHERE inv1.cov > 1.5 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

SELECT w_state, i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('1998-04-26' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('1998-04-26' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after FROM catalog_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cr_reason_sk = 11), warehouse, item, date_dim WHERE i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '1998-03-27' AND '1998-05-26' AND i_category = 'Home' AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 67 AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 69 AND 88 GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100;

SELECT w_state, i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < CAST('2001-04-07' AS DATE) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= CAST('2001-04-07' AS DATE) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after FROM ( SELECT warehouse.w_state, item.i_item_id, catalog_sales.cs_sales_price, catalog_returns.cr_refunded_cash, date_dim.d_date FROM date_dim JOIN catalog_sales ON date_dim.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk AND catalog_returns.cr_reason_sk = 40 JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk JOIN warehouse ON warehouse.w_warehouse_sk = catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk WHERE date_dim.d_date BETWEEN (CAST('2001-04-07' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND (CAST('2001-04-07' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND item.i_category = 'Sports' AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 61 AND 100 AND catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 14 AND 33 ) AS sub GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100;

SELECT w_state, i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < DATE '2000-05-08' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= DATE '2000-05-08' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after FROM item JOIN catalog_sales ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk JOIN warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cr_reason_sk = 40 WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-04-08' AND DATE '2000-06-07' AND i_category = 'Books' AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 61 AND 100 AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 81 AND 100 GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100;

SELECT MIN(w_state), MIN(i_item_id), MIN(cs_item_sk), MIN(cs_order_number), MIN(cr_item_sk), MIN(cr_order_number) FROM item INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk AND item.i_category = 'Books' AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 61 AND 100 AND catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 81 AND 100 INNER JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN (CAST('2000-05-08' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND (CAST('2000-05-08' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY) INNER JOIN warehouse ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk INNER JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk AND catalog_returns.cr_reason_sk = 40;

WITH d2_filtered AS ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 4 ) SELECT store.s_store_name, store.s_company_id, store.s_street_number, store.s_street_name, store.s_street_type, store.s_suite_number, store.s_city, store.s_county, store.s_state, store.s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales JOIN store_returns ON store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk AND store_sales.ss_customer_sk = store_returns.sr_customer_sk JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk JOIN store AS s2 ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d1 ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk JOIN d2_filtered ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = d2_filtered.d_date_sk WHERE d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2_filtered.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY) AND d2_filtered.d_date GROUP BY store.s_store_name, store.s_company_id, store.s_street_number, store.s_street_name, store.s_street_type, store.s_suite_number, store.s_city, store.s_county, store.s_state, store.s_zip ORDER BY store.s_store_name, store.s_company_id, store.s_street_number, store.s_street_name, store.s_street_type, store.s_suite_number, store.s_city, store.s_county, store.s_state, store.s_zip LIMIT 100;

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales JOIN store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 5) d2 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100;

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30)) AS "30 days", SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60)) AS "31-60 days", SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90)) AS "61-90 days", SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120)) AS "91-120 days", SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120)) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim d1, date_dim d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 2002 AND d2.d_moy = 8 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY) AND d2.d_date GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100;

WITH month_seq_base AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1 AS start_seq, d_month_seq + 3 AS end_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy = 6 ), my_customers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM ( SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk, cs_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk, ws_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost FROM web_sales ) cs_or_ws_sales JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Electronics' AND i_class = 'portable') item ON cs_or_ws_sales.item_sk = item.i_item_sk JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2002) date_dim ON cs_or_ws_sales.sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk JOIN (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1991) customer ON cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk WHERE wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100 ), my_revenue AS ( SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue FROM my_customers JOIN (SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_sold_date_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100) store_sales ON my_customers.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ON my_customers.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk JOIN (SELECT s_county, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('AL','AR','FL','MN','MO','NC','NY','OK','PA','WI')) store ON customer_address.ca_county = store.s_county AND customer_address.ca_state = store.s_state JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT start_seq FROM month_seq_base) AND (SELECT end_seq FROM month_seq_base) ) date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk ), segments AS ( SELECT CAST((revenue/50) AS INT) AS segment FROM my_revenue ) SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, segment*50 AS segment_base FROM segments GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment, num_customers LIMIT 100;

WITH date_filter AS ( SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-04-16') ), ss_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev FROM store_sales JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter) AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123 AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953 GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year ), cs_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev FROM catalog_sales JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter) AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123 AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953 GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year ), ws_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev FROM web_sales JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter) AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123 AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953 GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year ) SELECT ss_items.item_id, ss_items.birth_year, ss_item_rev, ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev, cs_item_rev, cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev, ws_item_rev, ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev, (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average FROM ss_items JOIN cs_items ON ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year JOIN ws_items ON ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year WHERE ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev ORDER BY item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS ( SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-03-21') ), ss_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev FROM store_sales JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM filtered_dates) AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294 AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942 GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year ), cs_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev FROM catalog_sales JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM filtered_dates) AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294 AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942 GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year ), ws_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, c_birth_year AS birth_year, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev FROM web_sales JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM filtered_dates) AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294 AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942 GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year ) SELECT ss_items.item_id, ss_items.birth_year, ss_item_rev, ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev, cs_item_rev, cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev, ws_item_rev, ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev, (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average FROM ss_items INNER JOIN cs_items ON ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year INNER JOIN ws_items ON ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year WHERE ABS(ss_item_rev - cs_item_rev) <= 0.1 * cs_item_rev AND ABS(ss_item_rev - ws_item_rev) <= 0.1 * ws_item_rev AND ABS(cs_item_rev - ws_item_rev) <= 0.1 * ws_item_rev ORDER BY item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev LIMIT 100;

WITH wss AS ( SELECT d_week_seq, ss_store_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day_name = 'Sunday') AS sun_sales, SUM(ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day_name = 'Monday') AS mon_sales, SUM(ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day_name = 'Tuesday') AS tue_sales, SUM(ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day_name = 'Wednesday') AS wed_sales, SUM(ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day_name = 'Thursday') AS thu_sales, SUM(ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day_name = 'Friday') AS fri_sales, SUM(ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day_name = 'Saturday') AS sat_sales FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.37 GROUP BY d_week_seq, ss_store_sk ), y AS ( SELECT s_store_name AS s_store_name1, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1, s_store_id AS s_store_id1, sun_sales AS sun_sales1, mon_sales AS mon_sales1, tue_sales AS tue_sales1, wed_sales AS wed_sales1, thu_sales AS thu_sales1, fri_sales AS fri_sales1, sat_sales AS sat_sales1 FROM wss JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NM','OH','OR','TX') JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 AND 1218 ), x AS ( SELECT s_store_name AS s_store_name2, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2, s_store_id AS s_store_id2, sun_sales AS sun_sales2, mon_sales AS mon_sales2, tue_sales AS tue_sales2, wed_sales AS wed_sales2, thu_sales AS thu_sales2, fri_sales AS fri_sales2, sat_sales AS sat_sales2 FROM wss JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NM','OH','OR','TX') JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1219 AND 1230 ) SELECT s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1, sun_sales1 / sun_sales2, mon_sales1 / mon_sales2, tue_sales1 / tue_sales2, wed_sales1 / wed_sales2, thu_sales1 / thu_sales2, fri_sales1 / fri_sales2, sat_sales1 / sat_sales2 FROM y JOIN x ON s_store_id1 = s_store_id2 AND d_week_seq1 = d_week_seq2 - 52 ORDER BY s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1 LIMIT 100;

WITH wss AS ( SELECT d_week_seq, ss_store_sk, SUM(CASE WHEN d_day_name = 'Sunday' THEN ss_sales_price END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN d_day_name = 'Monday' THEN ss_sales_price END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN d_day_name = 'Tuesday' THEN ss_sales_price END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN d_day_name = 'Wednesday' THEN ss_sales_price END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN d_day_name = 'Thursday' THEN ss_sales_price END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN d_day_name = 'Friday' THEN ss_sales_price END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN d_day_name = 'Saturday' THEN ss_sales_price END) AS sat_sales FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 0.80 * ss_list_price AND 1.00 * ss_list_price GROUP BY d_week_seq, ss_store_sk ) SELECT s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1, sun_sales1 / sun_sales2, mon_sales1 / mon_sales2, tue_sales1 / tue_sales2, wed_sales1 / wed_sales2, thu_sales1 / thu_sales2, fri_sales1 / fri_sales2, sat_sales1 / sat_sales2 FROM ( SELECT s.s_store_name AS s_store_name1, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1, s.s_store_id AS s_store_id1, wss.sun_sales AS sun_sales1, wss.mon_sales AS mon_sales1, wss.tue_sales AS tue_sales1, wss.wed_sales AS wed_sales1, wss.thu_sales AS thu_sales1, wss.fri_sales AS fri_sales1, wss.sat_sales AS sat_sales1 FROM wss JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1210 AND 1221) d ON d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq JOIN (SELECT * FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('IA','MS','NE','NY','OK','TN','TX','VA')) s ON wss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk ) y JOIN ( SELECT s.s_store_name AS s_store_name2, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2, s.s_store_id AS s_store_id2, wss.sun_sales AS sun_sales2, wss.mon_sales AS mon_sales2, wss.tue_sales AS tue_sales2, wss.wed_sales AS wed_sales2, wss.thu_sales AS thu_sales2, wss.fri_sales AS fri_sales2, wss.sat_sales AS sat_sales2 FROM wss JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233) d ON d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq JOIN (SELECT * FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('IA','MS','NE','NY','OK','TN','TX','VA')) s ON wss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk ) x ON s_store_id1 = s_store_id2 AND d_week_seq1 = d_week_seq2 - 52 ORDER BY s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1 LIMIT 100;

WITH sales_subquery AS ( SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1215 AND 1215 + 11 AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 22 * 0.01 AND 32 * 0.01 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk ), sb AS ( SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave FROM sales_subquery GROUP BY ss_store_sk ) SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, sc.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand FROM store JOIN sales_subquery sc ON store.s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND store.s_state IN ('GA','IL','TX') JOIN sb ON sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 16 AND 20 ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc LIMIT 100;

WITH store_revenue AS ( SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203 AND store_sales.ss_sales_price BETWEEN store_sales.ss_list_price * 0.68 AND store_sales.ss_list_price * 0.78 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk ) SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, sc.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand FROM store JOIN item ON item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 79 AND 83 JOIN store_revenue sc ON store.s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk JOIN ( SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave FROM store_revenue GROUP BY ss_store_sk ) sb ON sc.ss_store_sk = sb.ss_store_sk AND sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave WHERE store.s_state IN ('IN','NM','VA') AND item.i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc LIMIT 100;

WITH store_sales_cte AS ( SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1178 AND 1189 AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 0.45 * ss_list_price AND 0.55 * ss_list_price GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk ) SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, sc.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand FROM store JOIN store_sales_cte sc ON s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND s_state IN ('IN','MI','WI') JOIN item ON i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 83 AND 87 JOIN ( SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave FROM store_sales_cte GROUP BY ss_store_sk ) sb ON sc.ss_store_sk = sb.ss_store_sk WHERE sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc LIMIT 100;

SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3 FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca.ca_state IN ('MD', 'MO', 'OK') JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'U') AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND store_sales.ss_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221 ) store_sub ON c.c_customer_sk = store_sub.ss_customer_sk LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND web_sales.ws_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221 ) web_sub ON c.c_customer_sk = web_sub.ws_bill_customer_sk LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND catalog_sales.cs_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221 ) catalog_sub ON c.c_customer_sk = catalog_sub.cs_ship_customer_sk WHERE store_sub.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND web_sub.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL AND catalog_sub.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_d1 AS (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) SELECT i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq, SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo, SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM catalog_sales JOIN inventory ON cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk AND inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity JOIN warehouse ON w_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports') JOIN customer_demographics ON cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7 JOIN household_demographics ON cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' JOIN filtered_d1 d1 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d2 ON inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq JOIN date_dim d3 ON cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day' LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cr_order_number = cs_order_number WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 GROUP BY i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq ORDER BY total_cnt DESC, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq LIMIT 100;

SELECT MIN(i_item_sk), MIN(w_warehouse_name), MIN(d1.d_week_seq), MIN(cs_item_sk), MIN(cs_order_number), MIN(inv_item_sk) FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS catalog_sales JOIN inventory ON (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) JOIN warehouse ON (w_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk) JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) AS item ON (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7) AS customer_demographics ON (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) JOIN (SELECT * FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000') AS household_demographics ON (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d1 ON (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) JOIN date_dim d2 ON (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq) JOIN date_dim d3 ON (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion ON (cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk) LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cr_order_number = cs_order_number) WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day';

WITH filtered_item AS ( SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_current_price > 50 AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports') ), filtered_promotion AS ( SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' AND p_channel_tv = 'N' AND p_channel_radio = 'Y' AND p_channel_press = 'N' AND p_channel_event = 'Y' ), filtered_date AS ( SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY ), ssr AS ( SELECT s_store_id AS store_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns, SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM store_sales INNER JOIN filtered_date ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk INNER JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk INNER JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60 GROUP BY s_store_id ), csr AS ( SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns, SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN filtered_date ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk INNER JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk INNER JOIN filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60 GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id ), wsr AS ( SELECT web_site_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns, SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM web_sales INNER JOIN filtered_date ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk INNER JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk INNER JOIN filtered_item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60 GROUP BY web_site_id ) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM ( SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr ) x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100;

WITH ssr AS ( SELECT s_store_id AS store_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns, SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM ( SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48 AND ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_store_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_promo_sk IS NOT NULL ) AS store_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk AND store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY) INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_current_price > 50 AND item.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men') INNER JOIN promotion ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y' AND promotion.p_channel_press = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y' GROUP BY s_store_id ), csr AS ( SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns, SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM ( SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48 AND cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs_catalog_page_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL ) AS catalog_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk AND catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number INNER JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY) INNER JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_sales.cs_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk INNER JOIN item ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_current_price > 50 AND item.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men') INNER JOIN promotion ON catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y' AND promotion.p_channel_press = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y' GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id ), wsr AS ( SELECT web_site_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns, SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM ( SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48 AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND ws_web_site_sk IS NOT NULL AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ws_promo_sk IS NOT NULL ) AS web_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk AND web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number INNER JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY) INNER JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk INNER JOIN item ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_current_price > 50 AND item.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men') INNER JOIN promotion ON web_sales.ws_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y' AND promotion.p_channel_press = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y' GROUP BY web_site_id ) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM ( SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr ) x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM catalog_returns JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk WHERE d_year = 1998 AND ca_state = 'IL' GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state ), state_avg AS ( SELECT ctr_state, AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_val FROM customer_total_return GROUP BY ctr_state ) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return ctr1 JOIN state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_val ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001 AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state = 'OH' GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state ), state_avg AS ( SELECT ctr_state, AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_val FROM customer_total_return GROUP BY ctr_state ) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr1.ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return ctr1 JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk JOIN state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_val AND ca_state = 'OH' ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr1.ctr_total_return LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state), state_avg AS (SELECT ctr_state, AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_val FROM customer_total_return GROUP BY ctr_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return ctr1, customer_address, customer, state_avg WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_val AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'OR' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100;

WITH date_cte AS ( SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('1998-03-05','1998-06-15','1998-09-12','1998-10-31' ) ), sr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty FROM store_returns JOIN item ON sr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_month_seq IN (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_cte) AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45 AND sr_return_amt BETWEEN 141 * sr_return_quantity AND 170 * sr_return_quantity AND sr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62) GROUP BY i_item_id ), cr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty FROM catalog_returns JOIN item ON cr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_month_seq IN (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_cte) AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45 AND cr_return_amount BETWEEN 141 * cr_return_quantity AND 170 * cr_return_quantity AND cr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62) GROUP BY i_item_id ), wr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty FROM web_returns JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_month_seq IN (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_cte) AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45 AND wr_return_amt BETWEEN 141 * wr_return_quantity AND 170 * wr_return_quantity AND wr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62) GROUP BY i_item_id ) SELECT sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty, sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev, cr_item_qty, cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev, wr_item_qty, wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev, (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average FROM sr_items JOIN cr_items ON sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id JOIN wr_items ON sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id ORDER BY sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty LIMIT 100;

WITH date_filter AS ( SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('1999-03-22', '1999-05-27', '1999-08-04', '1999-11-10') ), sr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty FROM store_returns JOIN item ON sr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter) AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Women') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 3 AND 12 AND sr_return_amt BETWEEN 264 * sr_return_quantity AND 293 * sr_return_quantity AND sr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52) GROUP BY i_item_id ), cr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty FROM catalog_returns JOIN item ON cr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter) AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Women') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 3 AND 12 AND cr_return_amount BETWEEN 264 * cr_return_quantity AND 293 * cr_return_quantity AND cr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52) GROUP BY i_item_id ), wr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty FROM web_returns JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter) AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Women') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 3 AND 12 AND wr_return_amt BETWEEN 264 * wr_return_quantity AND 293 * wr_return_quantity AND wr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52) GROUP BY i_item_id ) SELECT sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty, sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev, cr_item_qty, cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev, wr_item_qty, wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev, (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average FROM sr_items JOIN cr_items ON sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id JOIN wr_items ON sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id ORDER BY sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty LIMIT 100;

WITH date_filter AS ( SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2002-02-09','2002-04-16','2002-07-16','2002-10-28') ), sr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id item_id, SUM(sr_return_quantity) sr_item_qty FROM store_returns JOIN item ON sr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_filter ON sr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Jewelry') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100 AND sr_return_amt BETWEEN 271 * sr_return_quantity AND 300 * sr_return_quantity AND sr_reason_sk IN (3, 20, 40, 43, 51) GROUP BY i_item_id ), cr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id item_id, SUM(cr_return_quantity) cr_item_qty FROM catalog_returns JOIN item ON cr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_filter ON cr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Jewelry') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100 AND cr_return_amount BETWEEN 271 * cr_return_quantity AND 300 * cr_return_quantity AND cr_reason_sk IN (3, 20, 40, 43, 51) GROUP BY i_item_id ), wr_items AS ( SELECT i_item_id item_id, SUM(wr_return_quantity) wr_item_qty FROM web_returns JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_filter ON wr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Jewelry') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100 AND wr_return_amt BETWEEN 271 * wr_return_quantity AND 300 * wr_return_quantity AND wr_reason_sk IN (3, 20, 40, 43, 51) GROUP BY i_item_id ) SELECT sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty, sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev, cr_item_qty, cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev, wr_item_qty, wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev, (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average FROM sr_items JOIN cr_items ON sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id JOIN wr_items ON sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id ORDER BY sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty LIMIT 100;

SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, COALESCE(c_last_name, '') || ', ' || COALESCE(c_first_name, '') AS customername FROM customer JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk JOIN household_demographics ON hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk JOIN income_band ON ib_income_band_sk = hd_income_band_sk AND ib_lower_bound >= 32287 AND ib_upper_bound <= 32287 + 50000 WHERE ca_city = 'Hopewell' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_returns WHERE sr_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) ORDER BY c_customer_id LIMIT 100;

SELECT customer_id, coalesce(c_last_name, '') || ', ' || coalesce(c_first_name, '') AS customername FROM ( SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id, c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE ca.ca_city = 'Pleasant Hill' AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 35577 AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 85577 AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk ) AS sub ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 100;

WITH store_sales_sub AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203 JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947 WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300 AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27 ), catalog_sales_sub AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203 JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947 WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300 AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27 ), web_sales_sub AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203 JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947 WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300 AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27 ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( (SELECT * FROM store_sales_sub) EXCEPT (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales_sub) EXCEPT (SELECT * FROM web_sales_sub) ) cool_cust;

SELECT cc_call_center_id Call_Center, cc_name Call_Center_Name, cc_manager Manager, SUM(cr_net_loss) Returns_Loss FROM call_center JOIN ( SELECT * FROM catalog_returns WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN ( SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 5 ) ) AS catalog_returns ON cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND date_dim.d_year = 1999 AND date_dim.d_moy = 5 JOIN customer ON cr_returning_customer_sk = c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -7 JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk AND ( (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree') ) JOIN household_demographics ON hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk AND hd_buy_potential LIKE '0-500%' GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_manager, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status ORDER BY SUM(cr_net_loss) DESC;

WITH filtered_date_dim AS ( SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 10 ), filtered_customer_demographics AS ( SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status FROM customer_demographics WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree') ), filtered_household_demographics AS ( SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential LIKE 'Unknown%' ), filtered_customer_address AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk FROM customer_address WHERE ca_gmt_offset = -7 ) SELECT cc_call_center_id AS Call_Center, cc_name AS Call_Center_Name, cc_manager AS Manager, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS Returns_Loss FROM call_center JOIN catalog_returns ON cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk JOIN customer ON cr_returning_customer_sk = c_customer_sk JOIN filtered_customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk JOIN filtered_household_demographics ON hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk JOIN filtered_customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_manager, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status ORDER BY SUM(cr_net_loss) DESC;

SELECT MIN(cc_call_center_id), MIN(cc_name), MIN(cc_manager), MIN(cr_net_loss), MIN(cr_item_sk), MIN(cr_order_number) FROM call_center JOIN (SELECT cr_call_center_sk, cr_returned_date_sk, cr_returning_customer_sk, cr_net_loss, cr_item_sk, cr_order_number FROM catalog_returns WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM date_dim WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 3)) AS filtered_cr ON filtered_cr.cr_call_center_sk = call_center.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim ON filtered_cr.cr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND date_dim.d_year = 1999 AND date_dim.d_moy = 3 JOIN customer ON filtered_cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics ON customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk = customer.c_current_cdemo_sk AND ((customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')) JOIN household_demographics ON household_demographics.hd_demo_sk = customer.c_current_hdemo_sk AND household_demographics.hd_buy_potential LIKE '>10000%' JOIN customer_address ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk AND customer_address.ca_gmt_offset = -7;

WITH avg_discount AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_disc FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND CAST('2002-02-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88 AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 85 * 0.01 AND 100 * 0.01 GROUP BY ws_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount" FROM (SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88) AS ws JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id BETWEEN 394 AND 593 OR i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) AS i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND CAST('2002-02-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) AS d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk JOIN avg_discount ad ON ws.ws_item_sk = ad.ws_item_sk WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 1.3 * ad.avg_disc ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_discount AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_val FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-31' AND cast('2001-01-31' as date) + interval '90' day AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77 AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 17 * 0.01 AND 32 * 0.01 GROUP BY ws_item_sk ) SELECT sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) as "Excess Discount Amount" FROM (SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77) AS web_sales JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id BETWEEN 749 AND 948 OR i_category IN ('Books','Home','Sports')) AS item ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-31' AND cast('2001-01-31' as date) + interval '90' day) AS date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk JOIN avg_discount ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = avg_discount.ws_item_sk WHERE ws_ext_discount_amt > avg_discount.avg_val ORDER BY sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_discount AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_val FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND CAST('1999-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 69 * 0.01 AND 84 * 0.01 GROUP BY ws_item_sk ) SELECT sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount" FROM (SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS web_sales JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id BETWEEN 423 AND 622 OR i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')) AS item ON item.i_item_sk = web_sales.ws_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND CAST('1999-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) AS date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk JOIN avg_discount ON item.i_item_sk = avg_discount.ws_item_sk WHERE ws_ext_discount_amt > avg_discount.avg_val ORDER BY sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

SELECT substring(warehouse.w_warehouse_name,1,20), ship_mode.sm_type, call_center.cc_name, sum(CASE WHEN (catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days", sum(CASE WHEN (catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk > 30 AND catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days", sum(CASE WHEN (catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk > 60 AND catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days", sum(CASE WHEN (catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk > 90 AND catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days", sum(CASE WHEN (catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk - catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 106) AS catalog_sales JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1193 AND 1193 + 23) AS date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE w_gmt_offset = -5) AS warehouse ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM ship_mode WHERE sm_type = 'TWO DAY') AS ship_mode ON catalog_sales.cs_ship_mode_sk = ship_mode.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM call_center WHERE cc_class = 'small') AS call_center ON catalog_sales.cs_call_center_sk = call_center.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY substring(warehouse.w_warehouse_name,1,20), ship_mode.sm_type, call_center.cc_name ORDER BY substring(warehouse.w_warehouse_name,1,20), ship_mode.sm_type, call_center.cc_name LIMIT 100;

SELECT SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20), sm_type, cc_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 30 AND cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 60 AND cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 90 AND cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM catalog_sales JOIN ( SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 AND 1230 ) AS d ON cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN ( SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE w_gmt_offset = -5 ) AS w ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ship_mode WHERE sm_type = 'OVERNIGHT' ) AS sm ON cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN ( SELECT * FROM call_center WHERE cc_class = 'small' ) AS cc ON cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 114 AND 143 GROUP BY SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20), sm_type, cc_name ORDER BY SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20), sm_type, cc_name LIMIT 100;

SELECT MIN(w_warehouse_name), MIN(sm_type), MIN(cc_name), MIN(cs_order_number), MIN(cs_item_sk) FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 114 AND 143) AS cs JOIN (SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE w_gmt_offset = -5) AS w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM ship_mode WHERE sm_type = 'OVERNIGHT') AS sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM call_center WHERE cc_class = 'small') AS cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 AND 1230) AS d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk;

SELECT item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM date_dim JOIN store_sales s1 ON d_date_sk = s1.ss_sold_date_sk JOIN customer ON s1.ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk JOIN item item1 ON s1.ss_item_sk = item1.i_item_sk JOIN store_sales s2 ON s1.ss_ticket_number = s2.ss_ticket_number JOIN item item2 ON s2.ss_item_sk = item2.i_item_sk WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1999 AND item1.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music') AND item2.i_manager_id BETWEEN 77 AND 96 AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND s1.ss_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 250 AND s2.ss_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 250 AND item1.i_item_sk < item2.i_item_sk GROUP BY item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk ORDER BY cnt;

SELECT item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Music') AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) AS item1 JOIN (SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 108 AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL) AS s1 ON s1.ss_item_sk = item1.i_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1999 AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = s1.ss_sold_date_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer WHERE c_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND c_current_addr_sk IS NOT NULL AND c_current_cdemo_sk IS NOT NULL) AS customer ON s1.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer_address WHERE ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL) AS customer_address ON customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL) AS customer_demographics ON customer.c_current_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 108 AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL) AS s2 ON s1.ss_ticket_number = s2.ss_ticket_number JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 79 AND 98 AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) AS item2 ON s2.ss_item_sk = item2.i_item_sk WHERE item1.i_item_sk < item2.i_item_sk GROUP BY item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk ORDER BY cnt;

SELECT item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Children', 'Women')) AS item1 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 182 AND 196) AS s1 ON item1.i_item_sk = s1.ss_item_sk INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 182 AND 196) AS s2 ON s1.ss_ticket_number = s2.ss_ticket_number INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 2 AND 21) AS item2 ON s2.ss_item_sk = item2.i_item_sk INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1999) AS date_dim ON s1.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN customer ON s1.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk INNER JOIN customer_address ON customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS customer_demographics ON customer.c_current_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk WHERE item1.i_item_sk < item2.i_item_sk GROUP BY item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk ORDER BY cnt;
